checksums.name: content_version_stamp
checksums.formula_detail: Sum of 116 (0x74) consecutive 4-byte signed integers from a fixed ROM table at _DAT_08018bd0 (FUN_08018bb4). Not a function of the save bytes; behaves as a build/version stamp rather than a per-save corruption checksum.

verified_on_samples.computed_hex: unknown (ROM table not present in workspace)

checksums.name: magic_strcmp
checksums.formula_detail: Plain strcmp-shaped byte compare (FUN_08018b98) between struct offset 0 and a ROM-resident expected string _DAT_08018c28. If the expected string also begins with 0x00, the loop short-circuits as a match on the first byte and never inspects bytes 2-7 ('imanoK'); this ambiguity could not be resolved without the ROM bytes behind _DAT_08018c28.

verified_on_samples.computed_hex: unknown (expected ROM string not present in workspace)

io_driver_functions.notes: EEPROM single 8-byte-block read via DMA3 serial bitstream; opcode nibble 0x030000 (EEPROM read command).
EEPROM single 8-byte-block write via DMA3 serial bitstream; opcode nibble 0x430000 (EEPROM write command); polls busy bit on 0x0D000000 for write-complete.
Write-verify: re-reads the just-written 8-byte block via FUN_0803ab1c and compares against expected data; returns 0x8000 on mismatch. Not a save-content checksum, an I/O robustness check.
DMA3 kickoff primitive targeting 0x0D000000 with busy-wait.
DMA control setup helper, write path only.
DMA control teardown helper, write path only.
Bulk reader: loops FUN_0803ab1c once per 8-byte block to cover an arbitrary [offset,len) range; bounds-checks against a device-descriptor size field.
Bulk writer: loops FUN_0803abd4 + FUN_0803acb8 (write-then-verify) once per 8-byte block.

fields.name: record_table

observed_values.note: 10 records x 0x2C(44) bytes; absolute file start offset unresolved, approximate per the sample's own periodic active-range scan (~0x02-0x1C8 span).

fields.update_mechanism: Each record: a zeroed 4-byte sub-field at record+0x00, a 13-byte packed-2-bit array (52 slots, values 0-2) at record+0x10..+0x1C, and a single packed byte at record+0x1D encoding three 0-6 values as a+b*6+c*36 (clamped to 5 on overflow).
fields.evidence: FUN_08018ae0 (reset, literal constants), FUN_08018908/FUN_08018884 (pack), FUN_08018950 (unpack/read), FUN_08018c2c (rebuild-on-save loop).

open_questions: Does FUN_08018b98's strcmp-shaped check actually gate on the 'imanoK' bytes at offset 2-7, or does it short-circuit on the leading 0x0000 at offset 0-1 and never inspect the string?

What is the record table's absolute starting file offset? Stride (0x2C) and count (10) are confirmed from FUN_08018ae0's literal constants, but the base pointer is an unresolved RAM symbol in this trace.
Is the struct+0x08 content/version stamp a meaningful per-save corruption checksum, or a constant build stamp (since it sums a fixed ROM table rather than the save bytes)?
What, if anything, consumes bytes 0x1DC-0x1FF? Proven absent from both traced I/O paths; could be dead EEPROM space or read/written by code outside this 154-function trace.
What gameplay event(s) trigger FUN_08018bd4 (load) and FUN_08018c2c (save)? Both are reached only via unresolved indirect jump tables in this trace, with no statically-known caller.

What do the 10 records and 5 score slots mean in gameplay terms? No semantic label is derivable from this workspace, and both available .sav samples are classified multi_state_mutated_save rather than organic gameplay saves.
